extracted text: The paper examines hypoeutectic Al–Si alloy A356 (EN AlSi7Mg0.3). Two sets of specimens were used: one from the original alloy billet produced through magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) stirring, and another from thixocast alloy. Heat treatment (T6) was applied on both sets of specimens, consisting of solution annealing at 548°C for 6 hours followed by water quenching and artificial aging at 160°C for 6 hours followed by water quenching. Mechanical properties for all four variants (A356, A356 T6, Thixo, Thixo T6) are provided in Table 2.
